primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Change From Baseline in log qHBsAg at Day 113 in response to multiple doses of ARC-520 versus placebo, using a a mixed effect model for repeated measures (MMRM). Includes parameter baseline as a continuous covariate, and treatment and visit as fixed factors, interaction of treatment and visit, and interaction of parameter baseline and visit.

groups.description: Placebo (low dose or high dose) 0.9% normal saline, once every 4 weeks for 4 doses plus daily oral entecavir (0.5 or 1.0 mg/day) or tenofovir (300 mg) throughout the study period

groups.description: Intravenous ARC-520 at 1.0 mg/kg, once every 4 weeks for 4 doses plus daily oral entecavir (0.5 or 1.0 mg/day) or tenofovir (300 mg) throughout the study period

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Intent to treat population: all participants who received at least 1 dose of study drug and had valid qHBsAg values at baseline and at least one time point on or after the Day 15 visit.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline in Quantitative Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (Log qHBsAg) at Day 113
